description:
-= Spare Room =-
You are in a spare room. An ordinary kind of place. I guess you better just go and list everything you see here.



There is an unguarded exit to the east. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going north.
objective: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make an effort to take a trip east. With that done, look and see the box is locked. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
